role: read-only storage/resource audit; no remote writes or workloads launched

filesystem.alternative_storage_conclusion: No cheaply verified writable project alternative. Only mount root metadata and exact /ssd/jhy, /hdd/jhy existence checked; no other-user traversal, mkdir, write test or escalation.

resources.caution: Shared host snapshots are not reserved resources. No dedicated CPU/memory reservation exists. Nice/ionice/thread caps are priority/concurrency limits, not hard isolation.

bounded_existing_metadata.scope_note: Bounded metadata stat only, not another broad duplicate inventory. No giant logits, images, checkpoints, ZIPs or cache contents read. These sizes do not establish statistical adequacy or per-image confusion availability.

recommended_cpu_scan_gate.decision: Small streaming metadata-only CPU scan feasible; packaging deferred and not authorized by this audit.
recommended_cpu_scan_gate.output_budget_scope: 64 MiB applies only to metadata-audit summaries, not new-factory per-image confusion matrices. Coordinator estimates 133 vectors at approximately 91 MiB uncompressed; this output needs separate storage/peak-temporary-space budgeting.
recommended_cpu_scan_gate.authorization_status: No RUN_NOW authorization. No scans, implementation or workload launch. Remote audit ended; no further remote I/O.
launch_requirements: serial csv/json streaming, no worker pool or torch/CUDA import
recommended_cpu_scan_gate.storage_gate: Recheck actual available bytes before and during any later write. Require available minus bounded output budget to remain above max(active policy minimum, current formal-run growth reserve). Formal growth reserve not established here, so packaging remains blocked. The known prior GPU3 policy floor is 6 GiB, not sufficient by itself to budget two growing formal runs.
recommended_cpu_scan_gate.packaging: No ZIP, PNG export, copied caches or prediction generation in initial scan. Later packaging requires an exact output estimate, peak temporary-storage factor, refreshed free-space snapshot and explicit coordinator gate; no fallback to /ssd or /hdd without confirmed project write access.
recommended_cpu_scan_gate.scientific_limitation: Aggregate/confusion summaries support historical evidence review but cannot recreate changed calibrated argmax predictions; missing required per-image statistics must be reported, not regenerated through GPU or giant-cache sweeps.
